title: Chinese herbal Jianpi Jiedu formula suppressed colorectal cancer growth in vitro and in vivo via modulating hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha-mediated fibroblasts activation.
authors: He, Shenglan; Hao, Lixiao; Chen, Youlan; Gong, Biao; Xu, Xiaowen
one_liner_zh: 研究中药健脾解毒方通过HIF1α调控成纤维细胞活化抑制结直肠癌，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Jianpi Jiedu Formula (JPJDF) is a traditional Chinese medicinal decoction clinically used for its anti-cancer properties, particularly in colorectal cancer (CRC). AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to investigate the therapeutic effects of JPJDF on CRC and elucidate its potential molecular mechanisms, with a focus on its impact on hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha (HIF1alpha) and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) both in vitro and in vivo. MATERIALS AND METHODS: UPLC-Q-TOF-MS was used to identify the constituents of JPJDF. A chemical-induced colorectal cancer model was established and treated with JPJDF to evaluate its effects. Tumor size was measured, and histopathological analyses were performed to examine JPJDF's regulatory potential on CRC. The functional mechanism of JPJDF was predicted through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and transcriptomics. Co-culture techniques involving CRC cells and CCD-18Co fibroblasts were used to assess JPJDF's impact on fibroblast activation. The effects of HIF1alpha on CAFs were evaluated using CCK-8 proliferation, clonal formation, and apoptotic assays, with differential marker expression quantified via qPCR and Western blotting. RESULTS: Pharmacodynamic assessment demonstrated that JPJDF reduced tumor size without affecting body weight, indicating its safety in the chemical-induced murine CRC model. Network pharmacology analysis, combined with molecular docking and transcriptomics, revealed that JPJDF regulates HIF-1 signaling pathways and identified HIF1alpha as a potential target for JPJDF's anti-CRC effect. JPJDF effectively suppressed CRC growth in vivo by attenuating fibroblast activation, reducing alpha-SMA expression and POSTN secretion through HIF1alpha inhibition. HIF1alpha knockdown in CRC cells inhibited fibroblast proliferation and clonal formation, while overexpression promoted these processes. Additionally, downregulating HIF1alpha suppressed alpha-SMA and POSTN expression in fibroblasts, whereas overexpression enhanced fibroblast activation. CONCLUSION: JPJDF emerges as a promising therapeutic candidate for inhibiting CAFs activation by targeting HIF1alpha, offering potential avenues for modulating fibroblast activation towards CAFs in CRC therapy.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：健脾解毒方（JPJDF）是一种传统中药煎剂，临床上用于其抗癌特性，尤其在结直肠癌（CRC）中。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨JPJDF对CRC的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在分子机制，重点关注其对缺氧诱导因子1α（HIF1alpha）和癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）在体外和体内的作用。材料与方法：采用UPLC-Q-TOF-MS鉴定JPJDF的组成成分。建立化学诱导的结直肠癌模型，并用JPJDF处理以评估其效果。测量肿瘤大小，并进行组织病理学分析以检查JPJDF对CRC的调控潜力。通过网络药理学、分子对接和转录组学预测JPJDF的功能机制。采用CRC细胞与CCD-18Co成纤维细胞的共培养技术评估JPJDF对成纤维细胞活化的影响。使用CCK-8增殖、克隆形成和凋亡实验评估HIF1alpha对CAFs的作用，并通过qPCR和Western blotting定量差异标志物表达。结果：药效学评估表明，JPJDF在不影响体重的情况下减小了肿瘤大小，表明其在化学诱导的小鼠CRC模型中的安全性。网络药理学分析结合分子对接和转录组学揭示，JPJDF调控HIF-1信号通路，并确定HIF1alpha为JPJDF抗CRC效应的潜在靶点。JPJDF通过抑制HIF1alpha，减弱成纤维细胞活化，降低alpha-SMA表达和POSTN分泌，从而有效抑制体内CRC生长。CRC细胞中HIF1alpha敲低抑制了成纤维细胞增殖和克隆形成，而过表达则促进这些过程。此外，下调HIF1alpha抑制成纤维细胞中alpha-SMA和POSTN的表达，而过表达则增强成纤维细胞活化。结论：JPJDF通过靶向HIF1alpha抑制CAFs活化，成为有前景的治疗候选药物，为在CRC治疗中调节成纤维细胞向CAFs活化提供了潜在途径。
